items.title: Quantum adversary lifting through round bounds and the information cost of honest-but-curious two-party computation
items.author: Anurag Anshu; Shalev Ben-David; Srijita Kundu
items.source_version: Official complete39-pageCCC2021 publication,2021-07-08; detailedTheorems15/17 quantum lifting theme and completeSections4–5 author proofs, with secure-computation interpretation. Nativev1 is private transcription aid only.
items.difficulty_reason: The authors build a minimax characterization of monochromatic quantum information cost, convert products of information costs into sums through an iterative protocol reduction, and use the result to construct adversary weights while preserving the secure-computation positivity condition.
